description: Cancel a queued or running instance and stop its hourly billing. Use when the user wants to stop paying for a job — this is the normal way to end work. Call it with confirm:false first: that returns a preview of what will stop and changes nothing, so you do not need get_instance beforehand — the preview comes from the tool that will do the work, which a status read does not. Then call again with confirm:true. Cancelling ends the run: in-flight work not already checkpointed is lost, and the instance cannot be resumed.
name: cancel_instance
